A LITTLE MORE TO KNOW

Frequently asked questions

01Which rice should I choose for everyday cooking?

It depends on the meals you love. Matta rice has a distinctive colour and hearty texture, making it a familiar choice with Kerala curries. Jaya rice is another option for everyday meals. Explore our rice range ↗

02What makes Keerthi Nirmal rice special?

Our story is built on care, from selecting the grain to processing and packing it. We focus on preserving the familiar character of the rice that belongs at your table. Read our story ↗

03Which rice pairs well with a traditional Kerala sadhya?

Matta rice is a traditional accompaniment to a Kerala sadhya. Its distinctive texture pairs beautifully with sambar, avial, and the many flavours of a banana-leaf meal. Choose long or short grain to suit your preference.

04Where can I buy Keerthi Nirmal rice?

Visit the official Keerthi Nirmal website ↗ for current product information and buying enquiries. Availability and pack sizes can vary by location.
